result.note: The Venezuelan operatorship is only hoped for, so this tests the settled facts on ONGC's overseas stakes and how the Sakhalin-1 stake was retained.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the overseas oil assets of Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), as reported in August 2026:
items: ONGC regained its 20 per cent stake in Russia's Sakhalin-1 project in December 2025 after four years.
ONGC's overseas arm holds 40 per cent of the San Cristobal field in Venezuela.
ONGC retained its Sakhalin-1 stake by paying into the project's abandonment fund in US dollars.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because ONGC paid into the Sakhalin-1 abandonment fund in rubles, using dividends frozen in Russia. Regaining the stake lifted ONGC's quarterly revenue from the asset to roughly INR 10 billion (USD 105 million), from INR 5 billion to 6 billion earlier.
questions.source: ONGC retained the stake by paying into the project's abandonment fund in rubles using dividends frozen in Russia.
